title: epan: Separate fragment_head and fragment_item
description:
Separate fragment_head and fragment_item into two
different types of structs.

Remove "offset" from fragment_head, which was unused,
making fragment heads 4 bytes smaller.

Remove fragment_nr_offset, datalen, reassembled_in,
reas_in_layer_num, and error from fragment_item,
making them 24 bytes smaller.

Change a few dissectors which were using fragment_head
and fragment_item indistinguishably.

Ping #17311

there is some new clang analyzer with this change :

```
packet-obex.c:2361:25: warning: Access to field 'offset' results in a dereference of a null pointer (loaded from variable 'frag') [core.NullDereference]
packet-smb-pipe.c:3332:4: warning: Access to field 'offset' results in a dereference of a null pointer (loaded from variable 'fd_i') [core.NullDereference]
packet-smb2.c:6393:4: warning: Access to field 'offset' results in a dereference of a null pointer (loaded from variable 'fd_i') [core.NullDereference]
reassemble.c:1060:7: warning: Access to field 'offset' results in a dereference of a null pointer (loaded from variable 'fd') [core.NullDereference]
opcua.c:286:36: warning: Access to field 'offset' results in a dereference of a null pointer (loaded from variable 'frag_i') [core.NullDereference]
```

You can look https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/analysis/scan-build-2022-11-14-100552-3400-1/
